_comment: Copy this to ~/.config/ulanzi-obs/config.json and fill in your values. That file is git-ignored (it holds your OBS password). All keys are optional; defaults shown here.
_brbScene_comment: A scene-name PREFIX. The BRB key cycles every scene whose name starts with this (e.g. 'BRB 1', 'BRB 2').
_sceneColors_comment: Idle color per scene name OR per sequence base-name. Palette: cyan | green | red | amber | slate | white. Unlisted scenes default to cyan.
